verses.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered:
“Can a person do anything that benefits God? A wise person’s wisdom helps them.
Does the Almighty take any pleasure in you being in the right? Does he gain anything if you live without fault?
Is it because you honor God that he corrects you and takes you to court?
Isn’t your wickedness huge? There’s no end to the wrong you’ve done.
You took collateral from your own brother for no reason, and you stripped the clothes off people who had nothing.
You gave no water to those worn out with thirst, and you held back bread from the hungry.
But the powerful man got the land, and the man everyone honored got to live in it.
You sent widows away with empty hands, and the arms of the fatherless were broken.
That’s why traps are all around you and sudden terror shakes you,
or darkness keeps you from seeing and floodwaters cover you.
“Isn’t God high in heaven? Look how far up the stars are!
You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through all that darkness?
Thick clouds hide things from him so he can’t see. He walks along the vault of the sky.’
Are you going to stick to the old road wicked people walked?
They were swept away before their time. Their foundation washed away like a stream.
They told God, ‘Leave us alone!’ and asked, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
Yet he filled their houses with good things. I want nothing to do with the advice of the wicked.
The righteous see it and are glad, and the innocent laugh at them,
saying, ‘The ones who rose against us have been cut off. Fire has burned up what was left of them.’
“Get to know God now, and be at peace. Good will come to you that way.
Please take in what he teaches you and keep his words in your heart.
If you return to the Almighty and put wrongdoing far away from your tents, you’ll be built back up.
Put your treasure in the dust and your gold from Ophir among the stones in the streams.
Then the Almighty will be your treasure, your precious silver.
Then you’ll find joy in the Almighty and lift your face to God.
You’ll pray to him, and he’ll hear you. You’ll keep the vows you made.
You’ll decide on something, and it’ll be established for you. Light will shine on your paths.
When people bring you down, you’ll say, ‘Be lifted up.’ God will save the humble person.
He’ll even rescue someone who isn’t innocent. Yes, they’ll be rescued because your hands are clean.”
